changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.28
- New: community leaderboards on the dashboard (opt-in). A WEEKLY board you can click through per port (3074 / 27K / 30K / 7500), and an ALL-TIME board ranking total blocked traffic across all players.
- Turn it on in Preferences > Leaderboard > "Submit to leaderboard" (off by default). Your Bungie name identifies you on the board.
- Dashboard is now a 2x2 panel grid: clears + blocked traffic on top, weekly + all-time leaderboards below.
